description: Fetch Chaos — one-tap slingshot, chaotic dog physics. Throw it. Dog wrecks it.
name: fetch-chaos

scripts.build: npm run build:www && npm run cap:sync
scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html icon.svg manifest.webmanifest www/ && cp -r src www/
scripts.cap:android: npx cap add android && npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npx cap add ios && npm run build:www && npx cap sync
